description: Retrieval tuning knobs (Week 4 E2, FROZEN per Week 11 E2 / Week 14 E2 -- see docs/week11-threshold-freeze.md). Tuned against eval/golden/za.json via scripts/run_retrieval_eval.py. From the prototype freeze onward, ANY change here requires an eval delta AND E1 sign-off (plan W14: 'no new tuning without delta + E1 sign-off').

coverage_thresholds._note: Retrieval-side coverage gate. za 0.5 per Week 3 plan (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_15W_DETAILED.md W4: tune from eval deltas). Eval showed answerable in-corpus mean coverage 0.89; 0.5 keeps headroom above the observed minimum (0.7) while still refusing thin/out-of-corpus questions. ng 0.4 initial (Week 5: corpus is a small sample; tune against the NG golden slice before NG goes live -- see week5-tuning-note.md).

boosts._note: Post-fusion structural boosts (Week 5 E2, plan section 3.7: soft boosts post-fusion). Weights are additive score bonuses on the fused RRF score; they reorder but never add/remove hits. Any change here needs an eval delta (Week 4 gate).

baseline_eval.notes: 30 golden items: 11 answerable in held corpus (BCEA+Companies Act), 14 answerable targeting Acts not yet ingested (correctly refused by the coverage gate), 5 must-refuse (all refused).

regression_bars._note: CI eval-delta gate bars: a retrieval PR must not drop any metric below these floors. Recall/refusal floor is hard (blocking); MRR floor allows 0.05 drift pending golden-set growth.
